items.question_te: కింది వాటిలో Assamలో ఉన్న oil fields ఏవి? I. Digboi II. Moran III. Kalol IV. Naharkatiya
items.question_en: Which of the following oil fields are in Assam? I. Digboi II. Moran III. Kalol IV. Naharkatiya
items.hold_reason: The book prints option 2. The item remains unscored until the official final key is opened and verified. Geography note: Kalol is in Gujarat; Digboi, Moran and Naharkatiya are in Assam.
